blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The architectural design of Large Language Models (LLMs) is shifting from traditional full-attention-only models to hybrid models, which combine different attention modules to improve long-context efficiency and performance in length extrapolation and context extension. To explain why hybrid models work and how to design them better, we propose Mechanics of Long-Context Hybrid Models . As Part 1.1 of this series, we begin with hybrids of full attention and either sliding-window attention (SWA) or gated variants of linear attention (LA), represented by GLA and GDN. We first observe a Seesaw Effect in Context Extension : LA hybrids benefit more from long-context continual pretraining, whereas SWA hybrids perform better under length extrapolation. We attribute this behavior to differences in the positional inductive biases induced by these attention mechanisms. We find that SWA hybrids suffer from a Short-Context Learning Trap , Short-Window Weariness, and Long-Window Laziness, and require extended windows to enhance performance in continual long-context pretraining. For LA hybrids, we summarize the Matthew Effect of Hybrid Position Extrapolation and propose Sliding-Window Linear Attention , achieving 16 × \times training-free length extrapolation while maintaining 100% accuracy on NIAH-SK1 in 64k context length.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMS)的建筑设计正从传统的全心全意模型转向混合模型,这些模型结合了不同的关注模块来提高长文字效率和在长度外推和上下文扩展方面的性能. 为了解释混合模型为什么起作用以及如何更好地设计这些模型,我们提出“长文本混合模型的机械”。 作为本系列第1.1部分,我们从完全注意和滑入窗口注意的混合体(SWA)或以GLA和GDN为代表的有门的线性注意变体(LA)开始. 我们首先观察到“上下文扩展中的锯子效应”:LA混血儿从长文持续预训中受益更多,而SWA混血儿在长度外推中表现更好。 我们将此行为归因于这些关注机制所引发的位置诱导偏差的不同. 我们发现SWA的混合体受到短文学习陷阱、短文织物和长文织物的折磨, 需要扩展窗口, 对于LA混合体,我们总结了混合位置外推法的Matthew Effect 并提议滑行-温道线性注意(Sliding-Window Linear attention),实现16×\tims训练无长度外推,同时在64k个上下文长度上保持了NIAH-SK1100%的精度.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The architectural design of mainstream open-source Large Language Models (LLMs) ( Brown et al., 2020 ; Sun et al., 2024a ; Cai et al., 2024 ; Nex et al., 2025 ; Dubey et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025a ) is shifting from traditional full-softmax-attention-only models ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ; Ainslie et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024a ; Liu et al., 2025a ) to hybrid models ( Jamba et al., 2024 ; Agarwal et al., 2025 ; Gemma et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Kimi et al., 2026 ; Qwen, 2026a ; MiMo, 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) , which combine different attention modules across layers or heads and introduce different position embeddings to improve long-context efficiency and performance ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Kimi et al., 2025 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ) . To this end, we propose Mechanics of Long-Context Hybrid Models . Through systematic training, evaluation, mechanism analysis, and closed-loop validation, we analyze how different attention modules inside a hybrid model collaborate and how these collaborations affect length extrapolation and long-context performance, aiming to answer ” why hybrid models are effective ” and ” how to design them more effectively ” for long-context LLMs. • Why Hybrid? Hybrid models have become an important paradigm in LLM design ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ; Kimi et al., 2026 ; Qwen, 2026a ) . Compared with traditional RoPE-based full-attention-only models ( Su et al., 2024 ; Touvron et al., 2023 ) , hybrid models not only offer higher computational and memory efficiency ( Liu et al., 2024a ; Liu et al., 2025a ; Xu et al., 2026 ) , but also provide better performance in retrieval, state tracking, language modeling, and length extrapolation ( Puvvada et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026a ; Hu et al., 2026c ; Kimi et al., 2025 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . • Why Long-Context? LLMs need to support longer context ( Liu et al., 2025c ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Zeng et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) , and long context is one of the most important application scenarios for current hybrid models ( Puvvada et al., 2025 ; Kimi et al., 2025 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ) . At the same time, million-token-level contexts in the agentic era impose strong constraints on model architectures ( Li et al., 2025 ; Kimi et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . Relying solely on full attention is prohibitively expensive, while any single efficient attention is unreliable ( Yang et al., 2024a ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Kimi et al., 2025 ) . This makes hybrid models worth studying in long-context LLMs ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ; Qiao et al., 2026 ; Tan et al., 2026 ) . • Why Mechanics? There has already been substantial work discussing hybrid models from the perspectives of downstream task evaluation, scaling curves, or system efficiency ( Puvvada et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ; Qiao et al., 2026 ; Tan et al., 2026 ) , but these results often remain at the level of comparing the phenomenon of ”which model is better” ( Merrill et al., 2026 ; Qiao et al., 2026 ) . We instead focus on how different attention modules inside a hybrid model interact, collaborate, and affect length extrapolation ( Press et al., 2022 ) during inference and context extension during training. This is why we use Mechanics to summarize this series of works.

blocks.en: On account of this long journey involving comparisons across multiple hybrid modules, hybrid paradigms, and training scenarios, we proceed step by step. This paper is Part 1.1 of the whole series. • In Part 1 , we first discuss the hybridization of memory-constant sliding-window attention (SWA) or linear attention (LA) with full attention, which is also one of the most widely used classes of hybrid models at present ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ; Gemma et al., 2026 ; MiMo, 2026 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ; Qwen, 2026a ; Kimi et al., 2026 ) ; in subsequent work, we will continue to explore hybrid models such as sparse-attention hybrids ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Lai et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026c ; Hu et al., 2026b ) and compressed-attention hybrids ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Chu et al., 2026 ) . • In Part 1.1 , we start from the perspective of hybrid position, focusing on the length extrapolation (i.e. training-free generalization beyond the pretraining context length) and context extension (i.e. long-context continual pretraining that expands context length) performance of RoPE-based full-attention models, RoPE-NoPE hybrid-position full-attention models, SWA hybrid models, and LA hybrid models represented by GLA/GDN ( Yang et al., 2024a ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Qwen, 2026a ) . In this paper, we focus on the long-context language modeling ( Rae et al., 2019 ; Fang et al., 2024 ) , retrieval ( Kamradt, 2023 ; Hsieh et al., 2024 ) , and state-tracking abilities ( Kuratov et al., 2024 ) in pretraining; in subsequent work, we will continue to explore more advanced abilities in post-training and multi-modal training.

blocks.en: Regarding the results obtained in Part 1.1, we give a complete Takeaway List on the first page of the paper. Specifically, the contributions of this paper can be summarized as follows: • We compare RoPE-based full attention, RoPE-NoPE hybrid, SWA hybrid, and GLA/GDN hybrid, both layer-wise and head-wise, across model scales of 376M, 776M, and 1B through long-context retrieval, state-tracking, and language-modeling performance under length extrapolation in short-context pretraining and context extension after long-context continual pretraining. • On hybrid position , we find that hybrid models improve long-context performance and length extrapolation by combining NoPE with other positional biases, i.e., RoPE attention and gated linear attention ( Takeaway 1 ). They occupy distinct functional regions in the entropy-hit-rate scatter diagram, where the boundaries shift with the hybrid ratio ( Takeaway 4 , Tidal Effect ). • On SWA hybrids , we demonstrate that although SWA hybrids exhibit clear advantages in length extrapolation, they suffer from the short-context learning trap in context extension ( Takeaway 2, Seesaw Effect ). To address this, we improve SWA hybrids by enlarging the window size and applying the LongCE loss, and further summarize the underlying short-window weariness ( Takeaway 5 ). • On LA hybrids , we find that LA hybrids perform better in long-context pretraining, but are weaker in length extrapolation ( Takeaway 3 , No-Free-Lunch Effect ). Through our extended attention-entropy analysis, we observe that LA and RoPE attention exhibit similar patterns in the entropy-hit-rate diagram, and both can be viewed as position-biased attention. Based on this, we propose Sliding-Window Linear Attention , achieving 16 × \times length extrapolation with 100% accuracy on NIAH-SK1, and summarize the underlying Matthew Effect of Hybrid Position Extrapolation ( Takeaway 6 ).
blocks.zh: 关于在第1.1部分中获得的结果,我们在文件的第一页上提供了一份完整的《竹取清单》。 特别是,本文件的贡献可归纳如下: 我们比较了基于RoPE的全注意力、RoPE-NoPE的混合、SWA的混合和GLA/GDN的混合,在376M、776M和1B的模型尺度上,通过长文本检索、状态跟踪和语言模型的性能,在短文本前培训和上下文扩展中,在长文本后连续的预培训中,在长文本前培训和上下文外推中进行长文本检索。 在混合位置上,我们发现混合模型通过将NOPE与其他位置偏差,即ROPE注意力和入门线性注意力(Takeaway 1 )相结合来提高长文本性能和长度外推. 它们占据着不同的功能区,分布于 en-受打击率散射图中,其边界随杂交比率而变化(Takeaway 4, Tidal Effect ......)。 在SWA杂交种上,我们证明,虽然SWA杂交种在长度外推法上表现出了明显的优势,但它们在上下文延伸(Takeaway 2, Seesaw Effect .)中受到短文学习陷阱的影响. 为了解决这个问题,我们通过扩大窗口大小和采用LongCE损失来改进SWA混合体,并进一步总结潜在的短窗疲劳(Takeaway 5 ). 在LA杂交上,我们发现LA杂交在长文预训中表现较好,但长度外推力更弱(Takeaway 3, No-Free-Lunch Effect . 通过我们扩展的注意力-内向分析,我们观察到LA和ROPE的注意力在 en-重力-速率图中表现出相似的规律,两者都可以被看作位置偏重的注意力. 据此,我们提出滑行-温道线性注意(Sliding-Window Linear attention),实现16×x\时间长度外推,在NIAH-SK1上精确度为100%,并总结了"混合位置外推"(Takeaway 6)背后的马修效应.

blocks.en: On LA hybrids , we find that LA hybrids perform better in long-context pretraining, but are weaker in length extrapolation ( Takeaway 3 , No-Free-Lunch Effect ). Through our extended attention-entropy analysis, we observe that LA and RoPE attention exhibit similar patterns in the entropy-hit-rate diagram, and both can be viewed as position-biased attention. Based on this, we propose Sliding-Window Linear Attention , achieving 16 × \times length extrapolation with 100% accuracy on NIAH-SK1, and summarize the underlying Matthew Effect of Hybrid Position Extrapolation ( Takeaway 6 ).
blocks.zh: 在LA杂交上,我们发现LA杂交在长文预训中表现较好,但长度外推力更弱(Takeaway 3, No-Free-Lunch Effect . 通过我们扩展的注意力-内向分析,我们观察到LA和ROPE的注意力在 en-重力-速率图中表现出相似的规律,两者都可以被看作位置偏重的注意力. 据此,我们提出滑行-温道线性注意(Sliding-Window Linear attention),实现16×x\时间长度外推,在NIAH-SK1上精确度为100%,并总结了"混合位置外推"(Takeaway 6)背后的马修效应.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 The Rise of Hybrid Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 混合模式的兴起

blocks.en: LLM architecture design has shifted from traditional full-attention-only models to hybrid models ( Jamba et al., 2024 ; Agarwal et al., 2025 ; Gemma et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Kimi et al., 2026 ; Qwen, 2026a ; MiMo, 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) , combining attention modules with different forms, complexities, and position embeddings to mix information along the sequence dimension ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Kimi et al., 2025 ) . For example, Qwen-3.5 ( Qwen, 2026a ; Qwen, 2026b ) , Kimi-K3 ( Kimi et al., 2025 ; Kimi et al., 2026 ) , and OLMo-Hybrid ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) mix full softmax attention (e.g., GQA ( Ainslie et al., 2023 ) and MLA ( Liu et al., 2024a ) ) or sparse attention (e.g., DSA ( Liu et al., 2025a ) ) with linear attention (e.g., GDN ( Yang et al., 2025b ) and KDA ( Kimi et al., 2025 ) ). Gemma4 ( Gemma et al., 2026 ) , Inkling ( Thinking Machines, 2026 ) , and Mimo-v2 ( MiMo, 2026 ) mix full softmax attention with sliding-window softmax attention. GLM-5.3 ( Zeng et al., 2026 ; Bai et al., 2026 ) and MiniMax-M3 ( Minimax, 2026 ; Lai et al., 2026 ) adopt sparse-attention hybrids ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026b ) , while DeepSeek-v4 ( Xu et al., 2026 ) uses compressed-attention hybrids ( Chu et al., 2026 ) with different compression intensity. Hybrid attention often comes with hybrid positional biases and has position-embedding designs that differ from those in traditional models. For example, Jamba ( Jamba et al., 2024 ) , Kimi-K3 ( Kimi et al., 2026 ) , SWAN-GPT ( Puvvada et al., 2025 ) , and RNoPE ( Yang et al., 2026 ) also show that full-attention layers in hybrid models do not necessarily require explicit position embeddings like RoPE ( Su et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: LLM架构设计已经从传统的全心全意模式转向了混合模式(Jamba等,2024;Agarwal等,2025;Gemma等,2026;Li等,2025;Kimi等,2026;Quen等,2026a;MiMo等,2026;Zeng等,2026;Xu等,2026),结合了不同形式,复杂性和位置嵌入的注意力模块,以将信息与序列维相混合(Wang等,2025;Kimi等,2025)。 例如: Quen-3.5 (Quen, 2026a; Quen, 2026b.), Kimi-K3 (Kimi等人,2025年;Kimi等人,2026年),和OLMo-Hybrid(Merrill等人,2026年)混合了全软-最大注意(如GQA(Ainslie等人,2023年)和MLA(Liu等人,2024年a年)或很少注意(如DSA(Liu等人,2025年a年)),线性注意(如GDN(Yang等人,2025年b年)和KDA(Kimi等人,2025年)). Gemma4(Gemma等人,2026年),Inkling(思考机,2026年)和Mimo-v2(Mimo,2026年)混合了全软-window软-windmax. GLM-5.3 (Zeng等人, 2026年; Bai等人, 2026年)和MiniMax-M3(Minimax, 2026年;Lai等人, 2026年)采用稀疏杂交种. blocks.en: These hybrid models can be more computationally and memory efficient than traditional models, while achieving downstream performance close to or even better than traditional full-attention models. As a result, hybrid models have received increasing attention ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Kimi et al., 2026 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ; Qiao et al., 2026 ) . Among them, hybrids with fixed memory complexity, especially linear attention (LA) and sliding-window attention (SWA) hybrids, after the early exploration ( De et al., 2024 ; Botev et al., 2024 ; Ren et al., 2025 ) , have since been adopted by LLMs including Jamba ( Jamba et al., 2024 ) , GPT-OSS ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) , MiniMax-01 ( Li et al., 2025 ) , Qwen ( Qwen, 2026a ; Qwen, 2026b ) , Kimi ( Kimi et al., 2025 ; Kimi et al., 2026 ) , Nemotron-H ( Blakeman et al., 2025 ) , and MiniCPM-SALA ( MiniCPM et al., 2026 ) . They have also inspired fine-tuning attempts ( Lan et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Lan et al., 2026 ; Jolicoeur-Martineau et al., 2026 ) , and refined efficiency optimizations ( Sun et al., 2024b ; Hu et al., 2026a ) . Therefore, we start from this class of hybrids to study why hybrid models are effective and how to design them more effectively.
blocks.zh: 这些混合模型比传统模型在计算上和内存效率更高,同时实现下游性能接近甚至优于传统全心模型. 因此,杂交模型得到越来越多的关注(Wang等,2025;Kimi等,2026;Merrill等,2026;Qiao等,2026). 其中具有固定内存复杂性的杂交体,特别是线性注意(LA)和滑窗注意(SWA)杂交体,早期探索后(De等,2024;Botev等,2024;Ren等,2025),自此被LLMs所采用,包括Jamba(Jamba等,2024),GPT-OSS(Agarwal等,2025),MiniMax-01(Li等,2025),Quen等. blocks.en: 2.2 Long-Context Performance of Hybrid Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 混合模型的长期性能

blocks.en: Beyond efficiency, previous work also suggests that hybrid models can bring performance gains within the training context length ( Kimi et al., 2026 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . Early works ( Fu et al., 2022 ; Cooper et al., 2026 ) show that hybrid models can combine the advantages of traditional softmax attention in retrieval with the advantages of linear attention in state tracing. Kimi-K3 ( Kimi et al., 2026 ) and OLMo Hybrid ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) further verify at larger scales that LA hybrids can improve model expressivity and pretraining scaling efficiency. In addition to layer-wise hybrids, Hymba ( Dong et al., 2024 ) and HydraHead ( Tan et al., 2026 ) also verify the effectiveness of head-wise hybrids.
blocks.zh: 除了效率之外,先前的工作还表明混合模型可以在培训背景长度内带来绩效收益(Kimi等,2026;Merrill等,2026;Yang等,2026)。 早期的作品(Fu等,2022;Cooper等,2026)表明,混合模型可以将传统柔性马克斯注意力在检索中的优势与状态跟踪中的线性注意力的优势结合起来. Kimi-K3(Kimi等,2026年)和OLMo Hybrid(Merrill等,2026年)在更大的尺度上进一步验证了LA杂交可以提高模型的快感并预先训练缩放效率. 除了地层相通杂交外,Hymba(Dong等,2024年)和Hydrahead(Tan等,2026年)也验证了头相通杂交的功效.

blocks.en: Beyond empirical validation, some works have begun to analyze SWA and LA hybrids theoretically. For example, Wang et al. (2025) suggests that a ratio around 3:1 suits hybrid models, while Wu et al. (2023) points out that retrieval is mainly handled by full attention, whereas SWA or LA affects the training trajectory. Although these works explain the benefits of hybrid models, there is still a lack of mechanistic analysis of how attention modules cooperate based on their different positional inductive biases in length extrapolation and context extension. Based on this, can we combine the strengths and weaknesses of different attention modules in their positional-bias designs and derive new hybrid strategies that advance length extrapolation and context extension? These are the questions we study in this paper.
blocks.zh: 除了经验验证外,一些作品开始在理论上分析SWA和LA杂交. 以王等为例. (2025年)认为3:1左右的比例适合混合模型,而Wu等. (2023年)指出取回主要通过全注意处理,而SWA或LA则会影响训练轨迹. 虽然这些作品解释了混合模型的效益,但对于关注模块如何根据其在长度外推和上下文延伸上的不同位置诱导偏差进行合作,仍然缺乏机械分析. 在此基础上,我们能否将不同关注模块在位置-比斯设计中的优缺点结合起来,并衍生出新的混合策略来推进长度外推和上下文扩展? 这是我们在本文中研究的问题。

blocks.en: 2.3 Extrapolation based on Hybrid Models
blocks.zh: 2.3 基于混合模型的外推法

blocks.en: Besides improving long-context performance within the training length, hybrid models have also been shown to improve length extrapolation, or length generalization ( Press et al., 2022 ) . For example, iRoPE ( AI, 2025 ) , RNoPE ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , and SWAN-GPT ( Puvvada et al., 2025 ) use RoPE only in some layers and restrict the attention window of these layers during extrapolation, while retaining access to full context only in NoPE layers, achieving strong extrapolation performance. This hybrid position design has also proven to improve retrieval performance within the training length ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Similarly, in LA hybrids, Jamba ( Jamba et al., 2024 ) , Kimi-K3 ( Kimi et al., 2026 ) , and HypeNet ( Chen et al., 2026 ) find that RoPE can also be removed from full-attention layers, which also helps direct length generalization ( Press et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 除了改善训练长度内的长写性能外,混合模型还被显示可以改进长度外推法,或长度通论(Press等,2022.). 例如:iROPE(AI,2025年),RNOPE(Yang等,2026年),和SWAN-GPT(Puvvada等,2025年)只在一些地层使用ROPE,并限制外推时这些地层的注意力窗口,同时只保留了在NoPE地层的完整上下文访问,实现强外推性能. 这种混合位置设计也已证明能改善训练长度内的检索性能(杨等,2026. 同样,在LA杂交种中,Jamba(Jamba等,2024年),Kimi-K3 (Kimi等,2026年),和HypeNet(Chen等,2026年)发现RoPE也可以从全心全意地层去除,这也有助于直接长度通化(Press等,2022年).

blocks.en: Although LA hybrids do not use explicit position embeddings, this does not mean there is no positional bias. Linear attention also contains various position designs, some of which have already been used to improve traditional softmax attention and build stronger position embeddings or attentions ( Su, 2025 ) , such as FoX ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , DeltaFormer ( Zhong et al., 2025 ) , and PaTH ( Yang et al., 2025c ) . Accordingly, we can extrapolate LA hybrids in the same way as RoPE-NoPE hybrids by limiting position-biased attention to local windows while strengthening global perception in NoPE attention, which is also one of the contributions in this paper.
blocks.zh: 虽然LA杂交不使用显式位置嵌入,但这并不意味着不存在位置偏差. 线性注意也包含有各种位置设计,有的已经用于提高传统的软马克斯注意力并构建更坚固的位置嵌入或注意力(Su,2025). Fox (Lin等,2025), DeltaFormer (Zhong等,2025),和PATH (Yang等,2025c.)等. 因此,我们可以通过限制对本地窗口的有位置偏见的注意,同时加强NOPE关注中的全球认知,以与ROPE-NoPE混合体相同的方式推断LA杂交体,这也是本文中的贡献之一.

blocks.en: We conduct 4k short-context pretraining with 50B tokens and 32k long-context continual pretraining with 5B tokens at 376M, 776M, and 1B model sizes, and we also verify key conclusions by pretraining a 3B model with the configuration detailed in Table 2 in Appendix A . By default, we use length extrapolation performance to refer to long-context performance after 4k short-context pretraining and context extension performance to refer to that after 32k long-context continual pretraining. We abbreviate layer-wise hybrid as LH and head-wise hybrid as HH, and use RoPE and NoPE to denote full attention with and without RoPE, respectively. For example, SWA-NoPE-LH denotes a model where SWA and NoPE full attention are mixed by layer with a ratio of 3:1 ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Qwen, 2026a ; Puvvada et al., 2025 ) by default. For RoPE attention, we retain only the attention window of the nearest pretraining context length, 4k. For NoPE attention, we use a log-scaled attention extrapolation, increasing the attention-logit scale to prevent attention entropy from increasing as the context grows, with the log base equal to the pretraining context length ( Su, 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024b ) . As shown in Figure 5 , this hybrid extrapolation method significantly outperforms RoPE or RoPE-NoPE hybrids using Dynamic NTK interpolation ( bloc97, 2023a ; Liu et al., 2024b ) .

blocks.en: This observation motivates Takeaway 1 in this paper, From Hybrid Attention to Hybrid Position , because the gate mechanism in linear attention can be viewed as inducing a data-dependent position bias ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Zhong et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025c ) . In hybrid models, the hybrid position between NoPE and other position biases plays an important role in long-context performance, and we will provide a detailed analysis in Section 4 and Section 6 .

blocks.en: Takeaway 1: From Hybrid Attention to Hybrid Position Hybrid models improve long-context performance and length extrapolation through a hybrid position of NoPE and other position biases. blocks.en: We further conduct long-context continual pretraining. Figure 6 shows results on layer-wise hybrids, while Figure 7 shows those on head-wise hybrids. Notably, there exists a very interesting phenomenon. SWA hybrids, which perform best in length extrapolation, underperform the LA hybrids after context extension, as shown in Figure 8 and Figure 9 , and may even fail to surpass their performance under log-scaled NoPE extrapolation, which is more remarkable in layer-wise hybrids. We call this phenomenon of SWA hybrids being outperformed by LA hybrids in long-context pretraining the Seesaw Effect of Context Extension in SWA Hybrid , which is Takeaway 2 in this paper. In Section 5 , we will try to find the cause of this phenomenon and enhance the context extension of SWA hybrids through a deeper analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们继续做长篇预训 图6显示的是层相混合的结果,而图7显示的是头相混合的结果. 值得注意的是,存在着一个非常有趣的现象。 如图8和图9所示,SWA杂交在长度外推方面表现最好,LA杂交在上下文扩展后表现不佳,甚至可能无法在log-scaled NoPE外推下超越其性能,这在分层相间的杂交中更为显著. 我们称SWA混血儿在长文中表现优于LA混血儿的现象预先训练了SWA混血儿的"上下文延伸效应"(SWA混血儿为Takeaway 2). 在第5节中,我们将努力找出这一现象的原因,并通过更深入的分析,加强西南亚混合体的背景延伸。

blocks.en: Takeaway 2: Seesaw Effect in Context Extension of SWA Hybrid For the SWA-NoPE hybrid model, the advantage in long-context performance over the LA-NoPE hybrid is inverted after long-context continual pretraining. Moreover, this phenomenon is more remarkable in the SWA-NoPE layer-wise hybrid model.
blocks.zh: 外卖 2: SWA混合型环境扩展的锯锯效应 对于SWA-NoPE混合模型,长文本性能相对于LA-NoPE混合的优势在长文本持续预训后被倒置. 此外,这一现象在SWA-NoPE分层的混合模型中更为显著.

blocks.en: In contrast, LA hybrids benefit more from context extension during long-context continual pretraining, but lag behind SWA hybrids in length extrapolation. In other words, compared with SWA hybrids, LA hybrids exhibit stronger fitting capability within the training context length, yet weaker generalization beyond it. This phenomenon is consistent with the No-Free-Lunch principle in machine learning and neural network design, leading to Takeaway 3 in this paper, No-Free-Lunch Effect in LA Hybrids . In section 6 , we will try to figure out the position bias in LA hybrids and enhance their length extrapolation.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,LA混血儿在长文持续预训期间更多地受益于上下文扩展,但在长度外推法上落后于SWA混合. 换句话说,与SWA杂交种相比,LA杂交种在训练背景长度内表现出更强的相接能力,但超出这种能力的一般化程度更弱. 这种现象与机器学习和神经网络设计中的"无所取舍"(No-Free-Lunch)原则一致,导致本文"无所取舍"(Takeaway 3),"LA Hybrids中的无所取舍"(No-Free-Lunch Effect). 在第6节中,我们将试图找出LA混合体中的位置偏差,并增强它们的长度外推.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion on Hybrid Position
blocks.zh: 4. 关于 " 共同立场 " 的讨论

blocks.en: The effectiveness of hybrid models raises thought-provoking questions: why do RoPE/NoPE full attention, sliding-window attention, and linear attention each have shortcomings, but hybrid models can achieve better long-context performance within and beyond the training context length? What specific roles do NoPE and other position-biased attention play in the same model?
blocks.zh: 混合模型的有效性提出了令人深思的问题:为什么RoPE/NoPE充分关注,滑入-窗口关注,线性关注各有缺点,但混合模型可以在培训背景长度内外实现更好的长编剧性能? 在同一个模式中,没有PE和其他立场有偏见的注意发挥什么具体作用?

blocks.en: 4.1 Ratio Ablation and Noise Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.1 比率与噪音分析

blocks.en: To answer these questions, we first analyze NoPE head-wise hybrid models with different NoPE ratios. We choose head-wise hybrids because they let NoPE and other attention types collaborate in parallel within the same layer, making them better suited for role attribution than layer-wise hybrids, and avoiding the impact of layer order and functional differences at different depths.

blocks.en: We compare RoPE-NoPE-HH, SWA-NoPE-HH, GLA-NoPE-HH, and GDN-NoPE-HH with different hybrid ratios, 3:1, 1:1, and 1:3, using the same setup for pretraining on model sizes of 376M and 776M. We only conduct the first stage of pretraining with a context length of 4k, and apply a sliding window with a window size of 4k for RoPE attention in RoPE-NoPE-HH ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Puvvada et al., 2025 ) , as well as log attention scaling for NoPE attention in all hybrids to achieve better length extrapolation ( Su, 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024b ) . The results are shown in Figure 10 . The results indicate that a 3:1 RoPE-NoPE ratio performs best within and beyond the training length in most cases. While NoPE attention plays an important role in long-context performance and extrapolation capability, more NoPE attention actually weakens the extrapolation effect.

blocks.en: Particularly, we conduct noise experiments on the 1:1 NoPE head hybrids. We add Gaussian noise to NoPE heads or other position-biased heads and observe which part of the noise has a greater impact on downstream tasks such as RULER and BABILong in 4k context length as the variance increases. Surprisingly, as shown in Figure 11 , adding noise to the position-biased heads, including RoPE/SWA/GLA/GDN heads, has a greater impact on downstream long-context tasks. This contradicts the intuition that NoPE is more responsible for global information retrieval, tending to dominate long-context performance, prompting us to investigate further: what role does NoPE full attention play in the hybrid models, and why could adding only a small amount of NoPE attention improve the performance of the original RoPE model?
blocks.zh: 特别是,我们进行噪音实验 在1:1 NoPE头混合。 我们把高斯语的噪音加到NoPE头或其他有位置偏见的头上,并观察到随着差异的增加,哪个部分的噪音对下游任务有更大的影响,例如RULAR和BABILong. 令人惊讶的是,如图11所示,在位置有偏见的头部,包括ROPE/SWA/GLA/GDN头部增加噪音,对下游的长篇任务影响更大. 这与NoPE更负责全球信息检索的直觉相矛盾,倾向于主导长文本的性能,促使我们进一步调查:NoPE的充分关注在混合模型中扮演什么角色,为什么只能增加少量的NoPE关注来改善原ROPE模型的性能?

blocks.en: 4.2 Attention Analysis of Hybrid Position
blocks.zh: 4.2 对混合位置的注意分析

blocks.en: To analyze the role of NoPE full attention in the hybrid models more clearly, we carry out three more in-depth experiments on attention distribution for the RoPE-NoPE hybrids. 1. Hit Rate Experiment . Input the prompt of the 4k SK1 task in RULER ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ) , and calculate the probability that the top- k k attention score in RoPE or NoPE attention hits the position to be retrieved for the query tokens at the end of the input. This experiment determines whether RoPE or NoPE is more responsible for direct information localization. 2. Retrieval Head Experiment . Follow the definition of the retrieval head and streaming head in DuoAttention ( Xiao et al., 2024a ) and compare the retrieval scores in RoPE and NoPE attention. According to Xiao et al. (2024a) , a retrieval head is an attention head that preserves distant tokens in addition to the initial sink and the recent local tokens, whereas a streaming head primarily preserves the sink and local tokens. This experiment determines whether RoPE or NoPE reads distant content more frequently. 3. Attention Entropy Experiment : Count the attention entropy of RoPE and NoPE attention on the PG19 dataset ( Rae et al., 2019 ) . We normalize the entropy between 0 and 1 by dividing by the maximum possible entropy value, the logarithm of the context length. This experiment determines whether RoPE or NoPE attention has a broader attention range. Since retrieval scores are concentrated near 0 within ( 0 , 1 ) (0,1) , we divide them into three bins: high [ 10 − 3 , 1 ) [10^{-3},1) , medium [ 10 − 5 , 10 − 3 ) [10^{-5},10^{-3}) , and low ( 0 , 10 − 5 ) (0,10^{-5}) , and report each proportion. The results are shown in Figure 12 , where NoPE and RoPE show the biggest gap in the hit-rate plot when k = 64 k=64 . To better reflect the distinct roles of RoPE and NoPE attentions, we add a scatter plot where each point represents an attention head, using its attention entropy at 4k and its top-64 hit rate as its coordinates. In this entropy-hit-rate diagram , we also use different colors to distinguish the retrieval head and streaming head in RoPE and NoPE attention.
blocks.zh: 为了更明确地分析NoPE在杂交模型中充分关注的作用,我们进行了三次关于RoPE-NoPE杂交的注意力分配的更深入实验. 1. 命中率实验 在 RULAR (Hsieh 等, 2024 ) 中输入4k SK1 任务的快取, 并计算出在 ROPE 或 NoPE 注意中最高的- k k 注意分击中输入后端要检索的查询符的位置的概率 。 这一实验决定了ROPE还是NoPE更负责直接信息本地化. 2. 回收头实验. 遵循DuoAtenting(Xiao等,2024a)中检索头和流头的定义,并比较ROPE和NoPE关注中的检索分数. 根据萧等(2024a)的说法,取出头是注意头,除了初始的活水槽和最近的本地活水槽外,还保留了遥远的活水槽和本地活水槽;而流水头主要保存活水槽和本地活水槽. 这一实验决定了RoPE还是NoPE更频繁地读取远处的内容. 3. 注意Entropy实验:在PG19数据集上将RoPE和NoPE注意的注意Entropy数起(Rae等人,2019年). 我们通过除去最大可能的正弦值,上下文长度的对数,使0到1之间的正弦化. 这个实验决定了ROPE还是NoPE的注意力范围是否更广. 由于检索分数集中在 (0, 1) (0, 1) 以内 0, 我们把它们分为 三个 : 高 [10- 3, 1] [10- 3- 3] (10- 3- ), 中 [10- 5- 10- 3] [10- 5- 5], 10- 3- ), 和 低 (0- 10- 5- ) (0- 10- 5- ), 并报告每个比例. 结果如图12所显示,在K=64克=64克=64克时,NOPE和ROPE显示了命中率地块的最大差距. 为了更好地反映RoPE和NoPE注意的不同作用,我们增加了一个散射地块,每个点代表注意头,用它的注意率4k和它的上-64命中率作为坐标. 在这个反射率图中,我们还使用不同的颜色来区分ROPE和NoPE注意的回取头和流头.

blocks.en: Figure 13 : The results of attention analysis within 1:1 RoPE-NoPE-LH and among RoPE-NoPE-LH with different hybrid ratios. The tidal effect of hybrid position is still applicable in RoPE-NoPE layer-wise hybrid models.
blocks.zh: 图13:1:1范围内的RoPE-NoPE-LH以及混合比率不同的RoPE-NoPE-LH的注意力分析结果. 混合位置的潮汐效应仍然适用于RoPE-NoPE地层相向混合模型.

blocks.en: We first compare the RoPE-NoPE head-wise hybrid models with a 1:1 head mix. We find that NoPE attention has a higher hit rate, a higher retrieval-head proportion, and a higher attention entropy, mainly occupying the strip area from the upper middle to the lower right in the entropy-hit-rate diagram. In contrast, RoPE attention has a lower hit rate, a higher streaming-head proportion, and a lower attention entropy, mainly occupying the sector area extending outward from the lower-left corner in the entropy-hit-rate diagram. This indicates that NoPE mainly supports coarse global localization in the hybrid models, since it dominates the high-entropy region. However, the negative correlation between entropy and hit rate indicates that when NoPE achieves a medium or lower hit rate, its higher attention entropy may introduce more noise. That is why localization relying solely on NoPE is unreliable, and a higher NoPE ratio may imply worse performance.
blocks.zh: 我们首先比较了RoPE-NoPE头相向混合模型与1:1头相混合. 我们发现,NoPE的注意力有更高的命中率,更高的取回-头比例,以及更高的注意力 en,主要占据着从中上到右下角的从 en-头率图中的条状区域. 相形之下,ROPE的注意有更低的命中率,更高的溪流-头部比例,更低的注意力 en,主要占据了从 en-头-率图中从左下角向外延伸的扇区. 这表明"NoPE"主要支持杂交模型中粗糙的全球本地化,因为它主导了高通域. 然而, en和命中率的负相关关系表明,当NoPE实现中或更低命中率时,其更高的关注度会引入更多的噪音. 因此,仅依靠 " 无PE " 的地方化是不可靠的, " 无PE " 比率的提高可能意味着业绩更差。

blocks.en: This is even more evident in comparing RoPE-NoPE hybrids with different RoPE-NoPE ratios. As the NoPE ratio increases, the distribution of RoPE attentions in the entropy-hit-rate diagram gradually shrinks towards the lower-left corner. In contrast, NoPE attentions occupy the high-hit-rate region and extend to the low-hit-rate and high-entropy region simultaneously. This is just like a tidal lane, where traffic may travel in either direction, depending on certain conditions. Therefore, we name this redistribution, under the collaboration between position-biased attention and NoPE attention, the Tidal Effect of Hybrid Position , which is Takeaway 4 in this paper: position-biased and NoPE attention heads occupy distinct regions in the entropy-hit-rate diagram, and their functional boundaries shift with the hybrid ratio.
blocks.zh: 这在比较RoPE-NoPE混合体与不同的RoPE-NoPE比率时更为明显. 随着"无PE"比值的提高,在 en-受打击率图中RoPE注意力的分布逐渐收缩到左下角. 相形之下,NoPE的注意力占据了高发率地区,并同时延伸到了低发率和高发率地区. 这就像一条潮汐道,根据某些条件,交通可以朝两个方向行驶。 因此,我们把这种再分配命名为 " 立场有偏见的注意与无和平号注意之间的协作 " 、 " 混合立场的潮汐效应 " ,即本文中的Takeaway 4:立场有偏见和无和平号注意头占据着不同的地区,它们的功能界限随混合比率而变化。

blocks.en: Takeaway 4: Tidal Effect in Collaboration of Hybrid Position Effective collaboration of hybrid position relies on a minority of high-hit-rate NoPE attention with coarse aggregation and a majority of low-entropy position-biased attention (i.e., RoPE attention and gated linear attention) for noise reduction. In the entropy-hit-rate diagram, position-biased attention occupies a sector region extending from the lower-left corner, while NoPE attention occupies a strip region from the upper middle to the lower right, and their boundaries shift with the hybrid ratio.
blocks.zh: Takeaway 4:混合位置的有效协作依赖于少数高发率的无核电站注意力和粗放的低发率位置偏差注意力(即RoPE注意力和入门线性注意力)来减少噪音。 在 en-受打击率图中,位置偏差的注意占据从左下角延伸的扇区区域,而NoPE注意则占据从中上到右下角的条状区域,它们的边界会随混合比例而变化.

blocks.en: Notably, here we extend this effect from RoPE-NoPE hybrid modes to other hybrid models, including GLA-NoPE and GDN-NoPE hybrids. We will verify such an extension in Section 6 . Here, we first verify the Tidal Effect in RoPE-NoPE layer-wise hybrid models. Considering the impact of layer order and functional differences at different depths, we conduct the validation experiment on 3:1 RoPE-NoPE, 1 NoPE layer after 3 RoPE layers, 1:1 RoPE-NoPE, 1 NoPE after 1 RoPE layer, 1:3 NoPE-RoPE, 3 RoPE layers after 1 NoPE layer, and 1:1 NoPE-RoPE, 1 RoPE after 1 NoPE layer. We compare the hit-rate curve, retrieval score distribution, and attention entropy curve in both 1:1 RoPE-NoPE (NR) and 1:1 NoPE-RoPE (RN), and present the entropy-hit-rate diagram for 4 hybrids in 376M and 776M model sizes in Figure 13 . The relative rankings of hit rate, retrieval score, and attention entropy, and the distribution pattern between RoPE and NoPE attention are consistent with those in head-wise hybrid models. In addition, we find that attentions in upper layers tend to have higher hit rates and larger entropy for both NoPE and RoPE attentions.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,我们把这种效果从RoPE-NoPE混合模式扩展到了其他混合模式,包括GLA-NoPE和GDN-NoPE混合模式. 我们将在第6节中核实这种延期。 在这里,我们首先验证了RoPE-NoPE层相位混合模型中的潮汐效应. 考虑到地层顺序和功能差异在不同深度的影响,我们进行了3:1 RoPE-NoPE,3个RoPE层后1个NoPE层,1:1 RoPE-NoPE,1个RoPE层后1个NoPE,1个NoPE-ROPE,1个NoPE层后3个roPE层,1个NoPE-ROPE,1个NoPE层后1个ROPE等验证实验. 我们比较了1:1 RoPE-NoPE(NR)和1:1 NoPE-ROPE(RN)的命中率曲线,取回分数分布,以及注意力py通曲线,并提出了376M和图13中的776M模型大小的4个杂交体的命中率图. 命中率,取回分数,和注意力 en的相对排名,以及RoPE和NoPE注意力之间的分布模式,都与头相向的混合模型中一致. 此外,我们发现上层的注意力往往具有更高的命中率和更大的 en同为NoPE和ROPE的注意力.

blocks.en: To sum up, we clarify how RoPE and NoPE attention collaborate, extending Takeaway 1 to a more fine-grained level. Although NoPE attention enables training-free effective length extrapolation and a higher attention hit rate, its coarse global localization still requires collaboration with position-biased attention to maintain performance in long-context tasks as the distribution shifts with the hybrid ratio.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们澄清了RoPE和NoPE的注意力如何合作,将Takeaway 1推广到更精细的层次. 虽然没有PE的注意可以使培训无有效长度外推和更高的注意力命中率,但其粗糙的全球局部化仍需要与立场有偏见的注意相配合,以便在分配随混合比例的转移而变化时,保持长切任务中的性能.

blocks.en: Takeaway 1: From Hybrid Attention to Hybrid Position (Complete Version) Hybrid models improve long-context performance and length extrapolation through a hybrid position of NoPE and other position biases. Particularly, • On one hand, training-free effective length extrapolation can be achieved even for LLMs pretrained with full attention by limiting the attention scope of position bias. • On the other hand, although NoPE attention consistently aggregates global information, downstream performance still relies on collaboration with other modules.
blocks.zh: 外卖 1:从"混合注意"到"混合位置"(完成版本)的"混合"模型通过"无PE"和其他"位置偏差"的"混合位置"来改善长文本性能和长度外推. 特别是,一方面,即使对事先经过充分注意培训的法学硕士,也可以通过限制位置偏差的注意力范围,实现无培训有效长度外推。 另一方面,虽然没有PE的注意始终汇总全球信息,但下游的业绩仍然依赖于与其他模块的协作.

blocks.zh: 一方面,即使LLMS通过限制位置偏差的注意力范围而经过充分注意,也可以实现无培训有效长度外推.

blocks.en: 5.1 Short-Context Learning Trap of SWA Hybrids
blocks.zh: 5.1 SWA混合体的短期学习陷阱

blocks.en: We start the discussion by observing the perplexity curves, and this reveals a potential reason behind the reversal in downstream task ranking. Figure 14 compares the perplexity curves of SWA-NoPE, RoPE-NoPE, GLA-NoPE, and GDN-NoPE hybrids before and after long-context continual pretraining. For most models, the perplexity curve before long-context training rises clearly beyond the pretraining context length. After long-context continual pretraining, the curve becomes much flatter or steadily decreases, indicating that the model can support longer contexts and use context to predict the next token better.
blocks.zh: 我们首先观察复杂度曲线来开始讨论,这揭示了下游任务排名逆转的潜在原因. 图14比较了SWA-NOPE、ROPE-NOPE、GLA-NOPE和GDN-NOPE混合在长文连续预训前后的复杂曲线。 对于大多数模型来说,长文训练之前的通俗曲线明显地提升出训练前上下文长度. 经过长时间的文字连续预训后,曲线会变得相当平缓或平稳地下降,表明模型可以支持较长的上下文,并使用上下文来更好地预测下一个征兆.

blocks.en: However, SWA-NoPE hybrids show the opposite behavior. Because they already have strong extrapolation ability, their perplexity curves keep decreasing within 32k before long-context continual pretraining. After long-context continual pretraining, especially for layer-wise SWA-NoPE hybrids, the perplexity curve instead shows an upward trend: the loss on long-context positions decreases only slightly , while the loss on short-context positions drops abnormally strongly , and this phenomenon becomes more obvious as the model size increases. This means that long-context dependencies do not help SWA-NoPE hybrids make better predictions. Long-context continual pretraining of SWA-NoPE hybrids focuses too much on short contexts, and as a result, LA-NoPE hybrids surpass SWA-NoPE hybrids after long-context continual pretraining. We refer to this phenomenon as the Short-Context Learning Trap in Context Extension of SWA Hybrid . This explains why the seesaw effect emerges during context extension of SWA hybrids and refines Takeaway 2.
blocks.zh: 然而,SWA-NoPE杂交表现出了相反的行为. 由于它们已经具备了很强的外推能力,它们的迷惑曲线在长文持续预演前在32k以内不断下降. 经过长文连续的预训,特别是对分层的SWA-NoPE杂交后,通缩曲线显示上升趋势:长文位置的损失只略为减少;而短文位置的损失则异常地剧烈地下降;随着模型大小的增加,这一现象变得更加明显. 这意味着由来已久的依赖关系无助于SWA-NoPE混合体作出更好的预测. SWA-NOPE混血儿的长写预训过于注重短环境,因此,LA-NOPE混血儿在长写预训后超过了SWA-NOPE混血儿. 我们把这一现象称为SWA混合环境扩展中的短文学习陷阱。 这解释了为什么锯齿效应在SWA杂交物的上下文延伸过程中出现并精炼出Takeaway 2.

blocks.en: To further verify the existence of the short-context learning trap, we plot the parameter change ratios in Figure 15 , comparing SWA-NoPE, RoPE-NoPE, GLA-NoPE, and GDN-NoPE hybrids. The x-axis represents different layers, and the y-axis represents the parameter change ratios of the 𝑾 Q \bm{W}_{Q} and 𝑾 K \bm{W}_{K} matrices. Taking 𝑾 Q \bm{W}_{Q} as an example, let 𝑾 Q \bm{W}_{Q} and 𝑾 Q ′ \bm{W}_{Q}^{\prime} denote its values before and after long-context continual pretraining. We define the change ratio as ‖ 𝑾 Q ′ − 𝑾 Q ‖ 2 / ‖ 𝑾 Q ‖ 2 \|\bm{W}_{Q}^{\prime}-\bm{W}_{Q}\|_{2}/\|\bm{W}_{Q}\|_{2} . We first compute this ratio for each head within the same layer, and then average over heads. For head-wise hybrids, we separately aggregate NoPE heads and non-NoPE heads in each layer. For layer-wise hybrids, we do not make an additional distinction within each layer, and the non-NoPE layers and NoPE layers are interleaved at a 3:1 ratio.

blocks.en: We find that for GLA-NoPE and GDN-NoPE hybrids, the parameter change ratios of GLA/GDN and NoPE attention are close. In contrast, for SWA and RoPE attention, especially SWA, the parameter change ratio is significantly larger than that of NoPE attention in both layer-wise and head-wise hybrids. This suggests that during long-context continual pretraining, SWA and RoPE attention receive much more optimization in SWA-NoPE and RoPE-NoPE hybrids. For SWA, however, the window size remains fixed, so the range of context dependencies that it can model is still limited. Therefore, its abnormal focus on this bounded local branch is what drives SWA-NoPE hybrids into the short-context learning trap during context extension.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,对于GLA-NoPE和GDN-NoPE混合体,GLA/GDN和NoPE注意的参数变化比是相近的. 相形之下,对于SWA和ROPE的注意,特别是SWA,在分层和分头的混合体中,参数变化比明显大于NoPE的注意. 这表明,在持续进行长文预训期间,西澳大利亚妇女协会和ROPE的注意力在SWA-NOPE和ROPE-NOPE混合体中得到更多的优化。 然而,对于SWA来说,窗口大小仍然固定,因此它所能建模的上下文依赖范围仍然有限. 因此,它反常地聚焦于这个被捆绑的局部分支,是促使SWA-NoPE混合体在上下文扩展时被短文本学习陷阱所驱动.

blocks.en: 5.2 Short-Window Weariness and Long-Window Laziness
blocks.zh: 5.2 短窗织物和长窗织物

blocks.en: Motivated by Figure 15 , we enlarge the SWA window size during long-context continual pretraining of layer-wise SWA-NoPE hybrids. The idea is to use the abnormal focus on the SWA branch to capture longer context dependencies. Specifically, we increase the window size from 128 to 256, 512, 1024, 2048, and 4096. Following the scaling law of RoPE-based extrapolation Liu et al. (2024b) , we also compute the rotary base corresponding to each enlarged window size when the initial window size is 128, and the original rotary base is 10000. Figure 17 and Figure 18 compare the PG19 perplexity, RULER, and BABILong performance of SWA hybrids after enlarging the window. The results show that increasing the window size indeed improves downstream long-context performance, and a window size of 2048 gives the best results at both 376M and 776M scales.
blocks.zh: 在图15的推动下,我们通过连续预训地层型SWA-NoPE混合体的长文本,扩大了SWA窗口的尺寸。 这个想法是利用SWA分支的异常焦点来捕捉较长的上下文依赖性. 具体来说,我们把窗口的尺寸从128个增加到256个,512个,1024个,2048个,4096个. 按照基于ROPE的外推法Liu等(2024b)的缩放定律,当初始窗口尺寸为128个时,我们也计算出每个扩大窗口大小的回转基,而原来的回转基为1000个. 图17和图18比较了SWA混合体在扩大窗口后PG19的复杂度,RULAR和BABILong的性能. 结果显示,增加窗口尺寸确实改善了下游长文本性能,窗口尺寸为2048,在376M和776M两个尺度上都取得了最佳效果.

blocks.en: In addition, enlarging the window only exploits the short-context learning trap rather than emphasizing long-context dependencies directly. Therefore, we also use LongCE ( Fang et al., 2024 ) as the training objective for layer-wise SWA-NoPE hybrids in long-context continual pretraining. As shown in Figure 20 , both enlarging the window to 2048 and using LongCE improve the long-context performance of SWA-NoPE layer-wise hybrids, and the two methods can be combined. With both methods, SWA-NoPE-LH becomes competitive with GDN-NoPE-LH across different model sizes. Since the short-context trap in SWA hybrid long-context continual pretraining may not be limited to SWA-NoPE layer-wise hybrids, we further apply the same two strategies to SWA-RoPE layer-wise hybrids. Enlarging the window and using LongCE also improves the long-context training performance of SWA-RoPE-LH at different scales, making it close to GDN-RoPE-LH.
blocks.zh: 此外,扩展窗口只会利用短文本学习陷阱,而不是直接强调长文本依赖性. 因此,我们还将LongCE(Fang等人,2024年)作为长期连续预训的分层SWA-NoPE混合体的培训目标。 如图20所示,将窗口扩展至2048并使用LongCE都改善了SWA-NoPE层相位混合的长文本性能,两种方法可以合并. 通过这两种方法,SWA-NoPE-LH与GDN-NoPE-LH在不同的模型大小上变得具有竞争力. 由于SWA杂交长文连续预训中的短文陷阱可能不限于SWA-NoPE分层杂交,我们进一步对SWA-ROPE分层杂交采用相同的两种策略. 打开窗口并使用LongCE也提高了SWA-ROPE-LH在不同尺度上的长文本训练性能,使其接近GDN-ROPE-LH.

blocks.en:
These results show that keeping a small SWA window during long-context continual pretraining harms context extension. SWA hybrids suffer from the short-context learning trap and require enlarged windows as well as training strategies that emphasize long-context learning . We call this phenomenon Short-Window Weariness of SWA Hybrid . At the same time, some previous works have reported that for SWA hybrids, shorter windows can be more advantageous than longer windows during the initial training stage, because they better activate the potential of NoPE full-attention layers ( Hu et al., 2026c ; Qiao et al., 2026 ) ; this phenomenon is sometimes called Long-Window Laziness . We argue that the two observations are not contradictory.
In fact, we can also verify this tendency as shown in Figure 17 and Figure 19 .
The coexistence of short-window weariness and long-window laziness indicates that SWA hybrids may require fine-grained adjustment of positional bias across short-context and long-context training stages, just as RoPE full-attention models need to tune the rotary base and scaling factor in context extension ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Peng et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Xiong et al., 2024 ) . We summarize the coexistence of short-window weariness and long-window laziness as Takeaway 5 in this paper.

blocks.en: The biggest difference between linear attention and softmax attention is that linear attention does not have a standard attention distribution, and its attention scores are not necessarily non-negative. Therefore, we cannot compute the attention entropy directly. Of course, one could apply softmax to the attention scores of linear attention and obtain a distribution, but this is inconsistent with the original computation of linear attention. Before analyzing linear attention, we therefore need a method that extends concepts such as attention distribution and attention entropy to arbitrary attention mechanisms, compatible with softmax attention and without extra operations on other attention algorithms.

Correspondingly, SWA also struggles to hit key information in the previous context, and its points stay close to the x-axis in the entropy-hit-rate diagram. blocks.en: 6.2 Length Extrapolation of LA Hybrid
blocks.zh: 6.2 LA混合体长度外推法

blocks.en: In RoPE-NoPE hybrids, we achieve length extrapolation beyond traditional NTK interpolation by treating RoPE attention as a sliding-window attention module with a 4k window, while keeping NoPE attention globally aware and strengthening it in a log-scale correction ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Puvvada et al., 2025 ) . For LA-NoPE hybrids, we analogously propose Sliding-Window Linear Attention , which applies a sliding window to linear attention with gates. This may sound counterintuitive, because it appears to conflict with the recurrent nature of linear attention, but it can still be implemented. Without modifying FLA kernels ( Yang and Zhang, 2024 ) , we use an approximation similar to sliding-window perplexity evaluation ( Press et al., 2022 ) . Suppose the window size is 4096 and the stride is 1024. We can use the original GLA or GDN operator to compute attention on chunks [ 0 , 4095 ] , [ 1024 , 5119 ] , [ 2048 , 6143 ] , ⋯ [0,4095],[1024,5119],[2048,6143],\cdots in parallel, and then extract the outputs at [ 0 , 4095 ] , [ 4096 , 5119 ] , [ 5120 , 6143 ] , ⋯ [0,4095],[4096,5119],[5120,6143],\cdots before stacking them back together. This implementation is independent of the internal details of a specific LA variant.
blocks.zh: 在RoPE-NoPE混合体中,我们通过将RoPE注意力作为有4k窗口的滑动-窗口注意力模块来进行超出传统NTK插值的长度外推,同时使NoPE注意力在全球范围得到注意,并在日志尺度校正中予以加强(Yang等,2026;Puvvada等,2025). 对于LA-NoPE混合体,我们相似地提议了滑行-温道线性注意(Sliding-Window Linear Record),它将滑动窗口应用于有门的线性注意. 这听起来可能与直觉相反,因为它似乎与线性关注的反复性质相冲突,但仍然可以执行. 在不修改FLA内核(Yang and Zhang, 2024)的情况下,我们使用了类似于滑窗穿透性评价的近似(Press等, 2022). 假设窗户尺寸为4096,走道为1024. 我们可以使用原GLA或GDN操作器计算出对块的注意[0,4095], [1024, 5119], [2048, 6143], [0,4095], [2048, 6143],\cdots并行进行计算,然后在 [0, 4095], [4096, 5119], [5120, 6143], [4096, 5119], [5120,6143],\cots堆回堆回前的输出. 这一实施独立于特定LA变体的内部细节.

After applying Sliding-Window Linear Attention, the number of factors accumulated in this product is bounded by the window size, implying that the relative-position signal is also restricted to the training length. As shown in Figures 23 and 24 , GLA-NoPE and GDN-NoPE hybrids with Sliding-Window Linear Attention achieve clear improvements in length extrapolation. Moreover, directly adding log-scale correction to the NoPE attention in LA-NoPE hybrids brings only limited improvement, but after applying SWLA, log-scale correction becomes much more effective. This strategy effectively relieves the no-free-lunch effect in length extrapolation of LA hybrids and also implies that even for linear attention with implicit positional bias, extrapolation should still restrict the relative-position range . This gives Takeaway 6 of this paper: in length extrapolation of hybrid-position models, position-biased attention should use a sliding window to restrict its relative-position information, while NoPE attention should strengthen its global perception. We call this phenomenon the Matthew Effect of Hybrid Position Extrapolation ,

blocks.en: In this paper, we verify the effectiveness of EME on RoPE-NoPE, GLA-NoPE, and GDN-NoPE hybrids, and further show that, for RoPE-NoPE hybrids, EME outperforms traditional interpolation methods. Figure 25 summarizes the comparison among three hybrid models extrapolated with EME and SWA-NoPE extrapolation. The four models show roughly comparable performance. We also highlight the results on the NIAH-SK1, SK2, and SK3 tasks in RULER, which are the most frequently reported tasks in hybrid model research. GLA-NoPE and GDN-NoPE with EME achieve 16 × \times training-free length extrapolation from a 4k training length to 64k inference length, while maintaining 100% accuracy on SK1. The results at the 776M scale are shown in Table 1 , with more reported in Table 16 . In fact, our finding is also consistent with reports from other work. For example, in Figure 5 of Chen et al. (2026) , the best extrapolating linear-attention hybrid is HypeNet-Lightning, and long-range decay is a key feature of Lightning Attention ( Qin et al., 2024 ) . Our approach based on SWLA further amplifies this property through the sliding window, breaks the traditional boundaries between SWA and LA, and is potentially compatible with arbitrary LA variants.

blocks.en: 6.3 Efficiency Comparison
blocks.zh: 6.3 效率比较

blocks.en: Additionally, we include a brief comparison of inference and training efficiency, as shown in Figure 26 and 27 . Regarding inference efficiency, we compare traditional full-attention-only models with 3:1 layer-wise or head-wise hybrid models that combine SWA, GLA, or GDN with NoPE full attention, across model sizes of 376M, 776M, 1B, and 3B. We measure prefilling efficiency with Time to First Token (TTFT) and decoding efficiency with Time per Output Token (TPOT), both in microseconds. We evaluate memory efficiency based on peak allocated GPU memory and cache size, both measured in GB. As shown in Figure 26 , hybrid models offer clear advantages as the model size and context length increase. Notably, although head-wise hybrids compute attention twice in every layer, the advantage in larger model sizes and longer context lengths is still remarkable. Similarly, regarding training efficiency, we compare training throughput on 8 H200 GPUs, measured by TGS (tokens per GPU per second) in 4k and 32k context lengths. We still compare full-attention-only models with 3:1 layer-wise or head-wise hybrid models on 376M, 776M, and 1B, without 3B, since training 3B models requires 16 H200 GPUs. As shown in Figure 27 , hybrid models still offer a larger throughput, especially for the 1B model size and 32k context length.
blocks.zh: 此外,如图26和图27所示,我们简要比较了推断和培训效率。 关于推论效率,我们将传统的全心全意模式与3:1分层或头部混合模式进行比较,这些模式将SWA、GLA或GDN与NoPE全心全意结合起来,在376M、776M、1B和3B的模型大小之间。 我们用"时间到第一托肯(TTFT)"(Time to First Token)来测量预填效率,并用"时间"(Time per Out Token (TPOT))来解码效率,两者均以微秒为单位. 我们根据最高分配的GPU内存和缓存大小来评价内存效率,两者都是用GB测量的. 如图26所示,随着模型大小和上下文长度的增加,混合模型提供了明显的优势. 值得注意的是,虽然头-头-脑混合体在每个层中计算出两次注意力,但更大的模型尺寸和较长上下文长度的优势仍然显著. 同样,关于培训效率,我们比较了8个H200GPU的培训吞吐量,按4k和32k上下文长度的TGS(每克GPU每秒)计算。 我们仍然将全心全意的型号与376M,776M,和1B上的3:1地层或头部混合型号进行比较,没有3B,因为训练3B型号需要16个H200GPU. 如图27所示,混合模型仍然提供更大的吞吐量,特别是1B模型大小和32k上下文长度.

blocks.en: Moreover, because the GLA and GDN variants store their recurrent states in higher FP32 precision, their resulting cache sizes are comparable to the cache overhead of the SWA hybrid with a window size of 128 and FP16 precision, so the corresponding curves overlap in the memory-efficiency comparison. In addition, because the QKV matrices of head-wise SWA hybrids are concatenated rather than split, as in head-wise LA hybrids, the intermediate memory footprint is larger, so head-wise SWA hybrids share the same peak inference memory as full attention and offer lower training throughput than LA hybrids.
blocks.zh: 此外,由于GLA和GDN变体以更高的FP32精度存储了它们的经常状态,因此它们产生的缓存大小可以与SWA混合体的缓存间接费用相媲美,其窗口大小为128和FP16精度,因此相应的曲线在内存效率比较中重叠. 此外,由于头智SWA混合体的QKV矩阵是相接而来而不是相分化的,如头智LA混合体中,中间内存足迹较大,所以头智SWA混合体与全注意力共享相同的峰值推断内存,提供比LA混合体较低的训练吞吐量.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we conduct extensive experiments to validate the effectiveness of the hybrid model in length extrapolation and context extension. Regarding hybrid position in NoPE attention versus other position-biased attention, we propose the Tidal Effect in collaboration and the Matthew Effect in extrapolation. We also discover the Seesaw Effect in context extension of the sliding-window attention hybrid models and the No-Free-Lunch Effect in length extrapolation of linear attention hybrid models. For SWA hybrids, we identify short-window weariness as well as long-window laziness and enlarge the window during extended training to overcome its Short-Context Learning Trap. For LA hybrids, we propose the Sliding-Window Linear Attention, achieving 16 × \times training-free extrapolation with 100% accuracy on NIAH-SK1 in 64k context length.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们进行了广泛的实验,以验证混合模型在长度外推和上下文延伸方面的有效性. 关于 " 无和平 " 关注与其他立场偏见关注的混合立场,我们提议合作的 " 潮汐效应 " 和 " 马修效应 " 推断法。 我们还在滑窗注意力混合模型的上下文扩展中发现了Seesaw Effect,在线性注意力混合模型的长度外推中发现了No-Free-Lunch Effect. 对于SWA混合体,我们发现短窗疲惫和长窗懒散,并在延长训练期间扩大窗口以克服短窗学习陷阱. 对于LA混合体,我们提出"滑行-温道线性注意"(Sliding-Window Linear attention),实现16×\\times无训练外推法,在64k个上下文长度的NIAH-SK1上精确度达到100%.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: This paper provides a mechanistic analysis of long-context hybrid models, with a broad training-validation-observation-induction loop. Even so, several directions remain open. • Validation scope . Our current validation pipeline is focused on context extension and length extrapolation in the pretraining stage. We still need to extend it to post-training ( Zeng et al., 2024 ; Nex et al., 2025 ) and multimodal, especially vision-language ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Wei et al., 2025 ) models. On that basis, we should also extend our evaluation to complex reasoning, agentic tasks, multimodal retrieval, and multimodal understanding. • Architecture scope . Our analysis focuses on RoPE/NoPE hybrids, SWA hybrids, and LA hybrids. We still need to apply the same mechanistic lens to other efficient hybrid families, such as sparse-attention ( Liu et al., 2024a ; Lai et al., 2026 ; Qwen, 2026b ) and compressed-attention ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Chu et al., 2026 ) models. We leave this broader comparison for future work. • Mechanism scope . Even within the hybrid families studied here, we only probe a subset of position and attention design choices. We will also further our study by analyzing techniques such as sink bias ( Xiao et al., 2024b ; Agarwal et al., 2025 ; MiMo, 2026 ) , partial RoPE ( Zeng et al., 2026 ; Qwen, 2026a ) , gated attention variants ( Qiu et al., 2026 ; Qwen, 2026a ) , and ablation of short convolution ( Yang et al., 2025b ; Yang et al., 2025c ; Thinking Machines, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 本文为长文混合模型提供机械分析,并有广泛的训练-验证-观察-上映回路. 即便如此,若干方向仍然开放。 • 鉴定范围。 我们目前的验证管道侧重于前培训阶段的上下文延伸和长度外推. 我们还需要将其扩大到培训后(Zeng等人,2024年;Nex等人,2025年)和多式联运,特别是视觉语言(Yang等人,2025年a; Wang等,2026;Wei等,2025)模型. 在此基础上,我们还应将我们的评价扩大到复杂的推理、代理任务、多式联运检索和多式联运理解。 • 建筑范围。 我们的分析重点是RoPE/NoPE杂交,SWA杂交和LA杂交. 我们仍然需要将同样的机械透镜应用于其他高效的杂交家庭,如: " 注意力稀少 " (Liu等人,2024a; Lai等, 2026; Quen, 2026b)和压缩意向(徐等, 2026; Chu等, 2026)型号. 我们将这一更广泛的比较留给今后的工作。 • 机制范围。 即使在这里研究的杂交家庭里, 我们只探索了一组位置和注意力设计选择。 我们还将通过分析诸如沉积偏差等技术来推进我们的研究(Xiao等,2024年b;Agarwal等,2025年;MiMo等,2026年),部分 RoPE (Zeng等, 2026; Quen, 2026a), 有门的注意变体 (邱等,2026;邱文等,2026a),并通晓了短演(杨等,2025b;杨等,2025c;想机,2026).

We follow the data mixture ratios used in Touvron et al. [2023] and Lv et al. [2024] , and increase the rotary base from 10000 to 500000 for RoPE full-attention to support contexts of around 64k tokens based on the scaling laws of RoPE-based extrapolation [ Liu et al., 2024b , Liu et al., 2025d ] . We use a 0.5M batch size and continue training for 5B tokens. We use the AdamW [ Loshchilov et al., 2017 ] optimizer with 0 weight decay, a peak learning rate of 1e-3, and a cosine annealing scheduler. We use the first 1B tokens for warm-up, and finally decay the learning rate to 0.

blocks.en: To validate the takeaways in this paper, we add evaluations on LongBench [ Bai et al., 2024 ] , a more realistic and comprehensive benchmark for long-context tasks. The evaluation is conducted with a maximum input length of 31500 and a maximum output length of 500. Although small-scale pre-trained models perform relatively poorly, the results on In-Context Learning (ICL) tasks [ Brown et al., 2020 ] still confirm our findings. Figure 28 compares SWA/GLA/GDN-NoPE hybrid models under log-scale NoPE extrapolation (Short-Log) and context extension (Long). The SWA-NoPE hybrids outperform in short-context extrapolation; however, after long-context training, layer-mixed LA-NoPE outperforms layer-mixed SWA-NoPE, while head-mixed LA-NoPE performs comparably to head-mixed SWA-NoPE, confirming the Seesaw Effect in LongBench evaluations.
blocks.zh: 为了证实本文中的外卖,我们增加了对Long Bench[Bai等,2024年]的评价,这是更现实和全面的长文任务基准。 评估的最高输入长度为31500,最高输出长度为500. 虽然小规模的预训模型表现相对较差,但In-Context Learning(ICL)任务的结果[Brown等,2020年]仍然证实了我们的调查结果. 图28比较了log-scale NoPE外推(Short-Log)和上下文扩展(Long)下的SWA/GLA/GDN-NoPE混合模型. SWA-NOPE杂交在短文外推上表现优于;然而,经过长文训练后,层相相通的LA-NOPE比层相通的SWA-NOPE,而头相通的LA-NOPE则比作头相通的SWA-NOPE,证实了长本克评价中的Seesaw效应.

blocks.en: We also validate the Matthew Effect of hybrid position extrapolation on the LongBench benchmark; Figures 29 , 30 , and 31 illustrate the extrapolation performance of RoPE-NoPE, GLA-NoPE, and GDN-NoPE, respectively, when employing this effect. We find that applying a sliding window for position-biased attention and a log scale for NoPE attention yields the best length extrapolation results on average. We also include detailed LongBench scores in Tables 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 and 23 .
blocks.zh: 我们还验证了Long Bench基准上混合位置推算的Matthew Effect; 图29、30和31分别说明了RoPE-NoPE、GLA-NoPE和GDN-NoPE在使用这种推算时的推算性能。 我们发现,采用滑动窗口进行位置偏差的注意和对无线PE注意的日志比例平均得出最优的长度外推结果。 我们还在表18、表19、表20、表21、表22和表23中详细列出Long Bench的分数。

blocks.en: To verify that the seesaw effect is stable, we first compare long-context continual pretraining results for SWA and LA hybrids at different peak learning rates, including 1e-4, 2e-4, 5e-4, and 1e-3, with 1e-3 as the default learning rate. We conduct this comparison at both 376M and 776M scales. We use the point with a zero learning rate to denote the direct length extrapolation result before long-context pretraining. As shown in Figure 32 , the seesaw effect remains stable under different learning rates: after context extension, SWA-NoPE hybrids, especially on long-context tasks, consistently lag behind LA-NoPE hybrids.
blocks.zh: 为了核实锯木效应是否稳定,我们首先比较了SWA和LA混血儿在不同的峰值学习率下的长期连续预训结果,包括1e-4,2e-4,5e-4和1e-3,以1e-3为默认学习率. 我们按376M和776M两个比例进行这种比较。 我们用零学习率的点来表示在长文预训前的直接长度外推结果. 如图32所示,不同学习率下的锯齿效应保持稳定:上下文扩展后,SWA-NoPE杂交,特别是在长文本任务上,始终落后于LA-NoPE杂交.

blocks.en: We also verify the existence of the Seesaw Effect in YOCO-like layer-wise hybrid models, in which all efficient-attention layers are placed at the lower layers. As shown in Figure 33 , the Seesaw Effect is a general phenomenon in SWA hybrids across different layer layouts. We further examine the enhanced context extension strategy based on enlarged window sizes, as well as LongCE and RoPE/GLA/GDN-NoPE extrapolation based on the Matthew Effect in layer-wise hybrid models in a YOCO-like layout, as shown in Figure 34 . However, although the enhanced SWA-NoPE context extension still works, the RoPE/GLA/GDN-NoPE extrapolation based on the Matthew Effect becomes less effective. The model behavior may still differ across layer-wise hybrid layouts, requiring in-depth observation, analysis, and verification.
blocks.zh: 我们还验证了YOCO类似地层相位相位混合模型中Seesaw Effect的存在,其中所有高效的注意层被放入下层. 如图33所显示,"Seesaw Effect"是不同地层布局的SWA杂交体中的一种普遍现象. 我们进一步审查了基于扩大窗口尺寸的增强上下文扩展战略,以及如图34所显示的以YOCO式布局的分层混合模型中的Matthew Effect为基础的LongCE和RoPE/GLA/GDN-NoPE推算。 然而,虽然增强的SWA-NoPE上下文扩展仍然有效,但基于Matthew Effect的ROPE/GLA/GDN-NoPE外推法却变得不那么有效. 模型行为在分层的混合布局上仍可能有所不同,需要深入地观察,分析和核实.

blocks.en: A.3 Broader Discussion
blocks.zh: A.3 更广泛的讨论

blocks.en: We have compared short-context training results for SWA hybrids with different window sizes in short-context pretraining and long-context pretraining above. During window-size extension, the RoPE base must be adjusted accordingly. When the window size is increased from 128 to 256, 512, 1024, 2048, and 4096, the RoPE bases, calculated according to the scaling laws for RoPE extrapolation [ Liu et al., 2024b ] and rounded up, become 90000, 700000, 6000000, 50000000, and 400000000, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了SWA混合体的短文本培训结果,上面的短文本预训和长文本预训的窗口大小不同. 在窗口大小扩展期间,RoPE基础必须作相应调整. 当窗口大小由128个增加到256个,512个,1024个,2048个和4096个时,按照ROPE外推的缩放定律来计算出ROPE基数[刘等,2024b]并取而代之,分别变为90000个,700000个,600000个,50000000个和400000个.

blocks.en: These values are clearly very large. This is because the initial window size is only 128, meaning that only a very limited number of dimensions have observed the complete positional information range; consequently, substantial interpolation is required. However, an excessively large RoPE base can reduce the discriminability of the position embedding. This motivated us to investigate the use of smaller RoPE bases in SWA. We kept the window size fixed at 128 and experimented with RoPE bases ranging from 5000 to 100 on both the 376M and 776M models. The results confirm that smaller bases can lead to better length extrapolation and context extension performance, as shown in Table 25 , but we do not observe a consistent trend across all settings. So we do not emphasize this finding in the main text. We will further investigate the underlying mechanism and try to develop an optimal scheduler for the training length, window size, and RoPE base in SWA hybrids.
blocks.zh: 这些价值显然很大。 这是因为初始窗口尺寸只有128个,这意味着只有非常有限的维度观察到了完整的位置信息范围;因此,需要大量的插入. 然而,一个过于庞大的ROPE基础可以降低嵌入位置的可歧视性. 这促使我们调查在西澳大利亚州使用较小的RoPE基地的情况。 我们把窗口尺寸固定在128,并在376M和776M型机上试验了5000至100个ROPE基座. 研究结果证实,如表25所示,较小的基数可导致长度外推和上下文扩展性能的改善,但我们并未观察到所有环境都呈现出一致的趋势。 因此,我们在正文中没有强调这一结论。 我们将进一步调查基本机制,并努力为西澳大利亚州混合型的训练长度、窗口大小和RoPE基地开发最佳调度器。

blocks.en: In the main text, we analyze LA hybrids by treating GLA and GDN as a whole. Nevertheless, there still exist differences within LA hybrids. For example, in short-context training, GLA hybrids are better at fitting but weaker at extrapolation than GDN hybrids, as shown in Figures 2 , 6 , 4 and 7 . In contrast, GDN’s fitting and extrapolation performance are more moderate, falling between GLA and SWA. However, when combined with SWLA, GLA hybrids show better length extrapolation performance than GDN hybrids, as shown in Figures 23 and 24 . Moreover, in the entropy-hit-rate diagram, GDN also occupies some part of the high-entropy hit-rate region while GLA does not, as shown in Figure 21 and Figure 22 . These differences imply that there might exist a mechanism related to the introduction of the delta rule [ Yang et al., 2024b ] , and we intend to conduct additional analysis in the future.
blocks.zh: 在正文中,我们通过将GLA和GDN作为一个整体来分析LA杂交. 尽管如此,LA混血体内部仍然存在差异. 例如,如图2、图6、图4和图7所示,在短文训练中,GLA混合体比GDN混合体更适合装配,而外推则更弱。 相比之下,GDN的配装和外推性能则较为温和,介于GLA和SWA之间. 然而,与SWLA结合后,GLA杂交显示的长度外推性能优于GDN杂交,如图23和图24所示. 此外,如图21和图22所示,GDN还占据了高强度命中率区域的一部分,而GLA则没有。 这些分歧意味着可能存在与引入三角洲规则有关的机制[Yang等,2024b],我们打算在将来进行更多的分析.

blocks.en: Inspired by the effectiveness of hybrid position, we also attempt to transfer SWA/GLA/GDN-RoPE hybrids trained in 4k short contexts to corresponding SWA/GLA/GDN-NoPE in the long-context training phase, namely dropping RoPE in long-context training like DRoPE [ Gelberg et al., 2026 , Merrill et al., 2026 ] . We report both short- and long-context evaluation results in Table 5 , 6 , 11 , 12 and 24 , and find no consistent pattern across models or sizes. This area may still need further exploration.
blocks.zh: 在混合姿势效力的启发下,我们还试图将经过4k个短背景培训的SWA/GLA/GDN-ROPE混合姿势转移到长文本培训阶段相应的SWA/GLA/GDN-NoPE,即将ROPE投放到长文本培训中去,如DROPE[Gelberg等,2026年;Merrill等,2026年]. 我们在表5、表6、表11、表12和表24中报告短文和长文评价的结果,没有发现各种模式或规模的一致模式。 这一地区可能需要进一步勘探。

blocks.en: We further analyze the hybrid position in hybrid models that combine RoPE with other attention mechanisms. As shown in Figure 35 , in SWA/GLA/GDN-RoPE hybrid models, RoPE attention loses the lower-left region of the entropy–hit-rate diagram and instead retains the outward sector region. The low-entropy region at the bottom is mainly occupied by SWA or LA, resulting in a distribution pattern similar to that of NoPE attention. This observation motivates us to rethink the characteristic distribution of NoPE attention: is the band-like distribution extending from the upper-middle to the lower-right a property of softmax attention in hybrid models, or is it intrinsic to NoPE attention itself?
blocks.zh: 我们进一步分析混合模型中的混合位置,将RoPE与其他关注机制结合. 如图35所显示,在SWA/GLA/GDN-ROPE混合模型中,ROPE的注意力会失去Entropy-hit-rate图中左下角区域,而是保留了外向区. 底部的低通体区域主要被SWA或LA所占据,因此其分布模式类似于NoPE关注. 这一观察促使我们重新思考NoPE关注的特征分布:从上中下右侧延伸出类似波段的分布是混合模型中软马克思关注的属性,还是NOPE关注本身所固有的属性?

blocks.en: Unfortunately, because NoPE-only models have inherent limitations, we are currently unable to answer this question. As shown in Figure 36 , at the beginning of training, NoPE attentions try to develop a trend that expands outward from the lower-left region of the entropy-hit-rate diagram, similar to RoPE attentions. However, as the loss fluctuates remarkably during training, this distribution pattern also collapses. In contrast, in standard RoPE models and RoPE-NoPE hybrid models, the features analyzed in the main text emerge after only a relatively small number of training tokens. Given the observed behavior of the NoPE-RoPE hybrid model and the instability of the NoPE-only model, we still regard the band-like distribution as a property of NoPE-based attention in the hybrid settings, rather than as a universal property of all softmax attention.
blocks.zh: 不幸的是,由于无PE模式具有固有的局限性,我们目前无法回答这个问题。 如图36所显示,在培训开始时,没有PE注意试图发展出从Entropy-hit-rate图中左下向外扩展的趋势,类似于ROPE注意. 然而,由于培训期间损失波动很大,这种分配模式也崩溃了。 相形之下,在标准RoPE模型和ROPE-NoPE混合模型中,正文中分析的特征仅出自相对较少的训练符. 考虑到被观测到的NoPE-ROPE混合模型的行为以及NoPE-只使用模型的不稳定性,我们仍然将波段式的分布视为在混合环境中基于NoPE的注意力的属性,而不是所有软马克斯注意力的普世属性.

blocks.zh: 附录B 详细评价结果

blocks.en: In this section, we first report the results of short-context evaluation. We evaluate both short-context and long-context models on downstream tasks mainly in Open LLM Leaderboard [ HuggingFace, 2023 ] , including TruthfulQA [ Lin et al., 2022 ] , LAMBADA [ Paperno et al., 2016 ] , PIQA [ Bisk et al., 2020 ] , HellaSwag [ Zellers et al., 2019 ] , WinoGrande [ Sakaguchi et al., 2020 ] , ARC [ Clark et al., 2018 ] , GPQA [ Rein et al., 2023 ] , SocialIQA [ Sap et al., 2019 ] , OpenBookQA [ Mihaylov et al., 2018 ] , SuperGLUE [ Wang et al., 2019 ] , and MMLU [ Hendrycks et al., 2021 ] . All models are tested within a 2k context length. The results are reported in Tables 3 , 5 , 4 and 6 . Hybrid models achieve performance comparable to the traditional RoPE-based full-attention-only model, before and after long-context continual pretraining.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们首先报告短文评价的结果。 我们评价下游任务的短文和长文模型,主要见于Open LLM Leaderboard [HuggingFace, 2023],包括 TruthfulQA [Lin等, 2022], LAMBADA [Pabno等, 2016], PIQA [Bisk等, 2020], HelaSwag [Zellers等, 2019], WinoGrande [坂口等,2020],ARC [Clark等,2018],GPQA [Rein等,2023],SocialIQA [Sap等,2019],OpenBookQA [MiHaylov等,2018],SuperGLUE [Wang等,2019],和MMLU [Hendrycks等,2021]. 所有模型在2k上下文长度范围内进行测试. 调查结果见表3、5、4和6。 混合模型在长文连续预训之前和之后的性能可与传统的基于RoPE的全心全意模型相媲美.

blocks.en: Regarding the experiments listed in the main text, we report the long-context performance of hybrid models after short-context pretraining in Tables 7 , 8 , 9 and 10 . The length extrapolation performance verifies the effectiveness of the Matthew Effect in extrapolation and the sliding-window linear attention. We also report long-context performance of hybrid models after long-context continual pretraining in Tables 11 and 12 . The context extension performance validates the Seesaw Effect of SWA Hybrids, while the length extrapolation performance validates the No-Free-Lunch Effect of LA Hybrids. We further detail the long-context performance of SWA layer-wise hybrid models with different window sizes in short-context pretraining and long-context continual pretraining in Tables 13 and 14 , validating the Short-Window Weariness and Long-Window Laziness. Besides, in Table 15 , we also report the long-context performance of SWA-LH after long-context continual pretraining with extended window sizes (wsz) and LongCE enhancement, both of which effectively relieve the short-context learning trap. We detail more NIAH results in the RULER evaluation in Table 16 to verify the effectiveness of sliding-window linear attention, and report the long-context performance of RoPE/SWA/GLA/GDN-NoPE-HH with different hybrid ratios in Table 17 .
blocks.zh: 关于正文中所列的实验,我们报告在表7、表8、表9和表10中的短文预训后混合模型的长文性能。 长度外推性能验证了"马修效应"在外推中的有效性和滑动-窗口线性关注. 我们还报告在表11和表12中长期预训后混合模型的长文本性能。 上下文扩展性能验证了SWA Hybrids的Seesaw Effect,而长度外推性能验证了LA Hybrids的"无所不至"效应. 我们进一步详细介绍了SWA分层混合模型的长文本性能,在短文本前训练和表13和表14中长文本前训练和长文本后继续预训的窗口大小不同,验证了短文本和长文本懒惰。 此外,在表15中,我们还报告SWA-LH在长文连续预训并用扩展的窗口尺寸(wsz)和LongCE增强后长文的性能,两者都有效缓解了短文学习陷阱. 我们更详细地介绍国家住房管理局在表16中评价欧盟驻科法治团的结果,以核实滑窗线性关注的有效性,并报告RoPE/SWA/GLA/GDN-NoPE-HH的长写性能,表17的混合比率不同。

blocks.en: Regarding the experiments listed in the Appendix, we also include detailed LongBench scores in Tables 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 and 23 , verifying the Seesaw Effect and Matthew Effect in different evaluation benchmarks. Additionally, in Table 24 , we verify the Seesaw Effect under different layer-wise hybrid layouts. Finally, in Table 25 , we report the long-context performance of SWA-NoPE-LH with different rotary bases in SWA.
blocks.zh: 关于附录中所列的实验,我们还在表18、19、20、21、22和23中详细列出了Long Bench的分数,在不同的评价基准中核实了Seesaw Effect和Matthew Effect。 此外,在表24中,我们验证不同层相混合布局下的Seesaw效应。 最后,在表25中,我们报告SWA-NoPE-LH在SWA具有不同回转基础的长文性能。

blocks.en: We provide these detailed results at the end of the paper to convey the excitement of discovering patterns through careful observation. Although the tables may appear tedious, reliable conclusions emerge only from momentary observations followed by repeated verification, just like Oersted’s accidental discovery during a classroom demonstration that an electric current in a straight wire could deflect a magnetic needle. Through subsequent verification and systematic induction, this observation became an important starting point for the development of electromagnetism. Although our mechanics of long-context hybrid models are still at an early stage, we believe that continued observation will reveal more of their underlying principles. We also hope that readers may discover, from these results, conclusions that we have not yet recognized.
blocks.zh: 我们在文件末尾提供了这些详细的结果,以通过仔细的观察来传达发现规律的兴奋. 尽管这些表格看起来可能很乏味,但可靠的结论仅来自短暂的观察,然后是反复的核实,就像Oersted在课堂演示中偶然发现的一样,直线电流可以使磁针偏转。 通过随后的核查和系统诱导,这一观测成为了电磁学发展的重要起点. 虽然我们的长文混合模型的力学尚处于早期阶段,但我们认为,继续观察将会揭示出更多的其基本原则. 我们还希望读者可以从这些结果中发现我们尚未认识到的结论。
